summary.intent: Wire CTR encryption mode into the SDK's uploadFile() for large media files, so newly uploaded media activates the streaming playback pipeline instead of always using GCM.
summary.outcome: CTR encryption is now correctly selected for large media files in both the SDK and web app, FLAC support was added, MIME type logic was centralized into sdk-core, pre-existing test failures were fixed, E2E tests passed, and a PR was created and reviewed.

repo: selectEncryptionMode() existed only in apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts and was never called for new SDK uploads — only for the duplicate-file re-encrypt path.

STREAMING_MIME_TYPES and CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD (256KB) were duplicated between packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts; consolidated into packages/sdk-core/src/encryption-mode.ts.
sdk-core pre-existing test failures: PublishIpnsResponseDto lost the `cid` field; ResolveIpnsResponseDto lost the `source` field; IpfsAddResult shape is { cid, size, recorded } not just { cid }.
The SDK imports compiled types from sdk-core's build output, so sdk-core must be rebuilt before typechecking the SDK.
FLAC files (audio/flac) were missing from STREAMING_MIME_TYPES in both the SDK client and web app streaming-crypto service.
The streaming-playback E2E spec had a test.skip on the CTR encrypted badge test that was intentionally deferred until this feature landed.
The web app's selectEncryptionMode takes a File object (browser API) while the centralized version takes (mimeType, size); web app now wraps the shared function.

code.finding: uploadFile() hardcoded encryptAesGcm and GCM mode; now accepts optional encryptionMode param and branches on CTR vs GCM.
uploadFile() now calls selectEncryptionMode() from sdk-core before delegating to sdkCore.uploadFile().
New module centralizing STREAMING_MIME_TYPES, CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD, selectEncryptionMode(), and normalizeEncryptionMode() to avoid duplication across packages.
Local selectEncryptionMode replaced with thin wrapper delegating to sdk-core's shared implementation.
Removed test.skip from CTR encrypted badge visibility test; all 6 streaming playback tests now pass including this one.

workflow: Build sdk-core before typechecking dependent packages (sdk, web) to avoid stale type errors.
Rebuilt sdk-core packages are picked up by the Vite dev server via HMR for E2E testing without restarting the dev server.
PR review comments from automated reviewers (CodeRabbit) flagged both the missing validation and the MIME type duplication — both were valid and addressed.

friction: sdk typecheck failed initially because sdk-core build output was stale — had to rebuild sdk-core first before the SDK could typecheck cleanly.
FLAC was missing from STREAMING_MIME_TYPES and only caught post-PR by the user, not during implementation.
MIME type list was duplicated in two places from the start; CodeRabbit had to flag it before it was centralized.
open_items: PR FSM1/cipher-box#399 targets fix/e2e-test-failures-v2 (not main); needs retargeting to main after that branch merges.
